episodes.title: Horizon High - Part One
episodes.summary: Peter is accepted into Horizon High, a school for geniuses, where his best friend Harry Osborn was just suspended; Peter makes his debut as Spider-Man and must battle the Vulture.

episodes.title: Horizon High - Part Two
episodes.summary: Spider-Man must work to stop the Scorpion from wreaking havoc at the museum.

episodes.title: Osborn Academy
episodes.summary: Norman Osborn creates the Osborn Academy for Geniuses as a way of saving his son Harry the embarrassment of being suspended from Horizon High.

episodes.title: A Day in the Life
episodes.summary: As the new academy gets up and running, Norman holds auditions for enrollment, which deepens the rivalry between Oz Academy and Horizon High.

episodes.title: Party Animals
episodes.summary: Horizon High throws a dance in honor of Harry being exonerated, but Norman asked Harry to stay at Osborn academy.

episodes.title: Sandman
episodes.summary: Spider-Man meets the powerful, yet uncontrollable Sandman and helps him reunite with his estranged daughter with the help of the Venom symbiote.

episodes.title: Symbiotic Relationship
episodes.summary: When Spider-Man uses his new black costume, he discovers that there is great danger in his new power; and he must find a way to defeat a costume that wants to destroy him.

episodes.title: Stark Expo
episodes.summary: After the terror of the symbiote, Spidey is off to the Stark Expo in his old costume. When Ghost hijacks the event, Spidey's only chance to save lives is to unleash the symbiote.

episodes.title: Ultimate Spider-Man
episodes.summary: When Miles Morales is bitten by an experimental spider and gains spider powers, Spider-Man must teach him the responsibilities of being a superhero.

episodes.title: Kraven's Amazing Hunt
episodes.summary: Kraven the Hunter does a live broadcast of his hunt for Spider-Man.

episodes.title: Halloween Moon
episodes.summary: On Halloween night, Spider-Man must team up with the incredible Hulk to stop Man-Wolf, a super-strong gamma-powered werewolf, from infecting the rest of Manhattan.

episodes.title: Spider-Man on Ice
episodes.summary: Spidey must stop a low-level villain who has acquired some impressive freezing technology.

episodes.title: Venom
episodes.summary: The symbiote has escaped the Avengers Compound and attached itself to a new host. Now Spidey must find out how to beat it and who the new person is underneath.

episodes.title: Screwball Live
episodes.summary: Spider-Man is targeted by a new costumed figure named Screwball for a series of online prank videos which block him from fighting crime.

episodes.title: The Rise of Doc Ock, Part One
episodes.summary: When Otto Octavius is caught in an explosion that fuses his robot arms to his body, Spider-Man sees the opportunity to recruit "The Octopus" into becoming a hero.

episodes.title: The Rise of Doc Ock, Part Two
episodes.summary: Spidey invites The Octopus to patrol the streets alongside Miles and himself until it becomes clear that Otto isn't exactly a team player.

episodes.title: The Rise of Doc Ock, Part Three
episodes.summary: Peter spends a day at Oz Academy in the hopes of finding a clue that will convince Harry that his Dad is out to destroy Spider-Man.

episodes.title: The Rise of Doc Ock, Part Four
episodes.summary: Spider-Man must team up with Gwen Stacy and a reluctant Harry Osborn to investigate the truth behind the missing Raymond Warren aka the Jackal.

episodes.title: Spider-Island, Part One
episodes.summary: Spider-Man and Miles Morales track down an unidentified villain with spider-powers who steals Peter's experimental stealth suit and equipment from Horizon High and Oscorp Academy.

episodes.title: Spider-Island, Part Two
episodes.summary: Everyone in Manhattan manifests spider powers; Spider-Man and Spider-Gwen must help Black Widow track down Crossbones before he delivers the vibranium to Arnim Zola and Hydra.

episodes.title: Spider-Island, Part Three
episodes.summary: Peter must find a way to cure Gwen Stacy and Norman Osborn after they turn into spider monsters; things get harder when Kraven the Hunter turns New York into his hunting grounds.

episodes.title: Spider-Island, Part Four
episodes.summary: Peter and Harry must battle through an island of spider monsters to get to Norman Osborn, who appears to control them all; the boys discover the real mastermind.

episodes.title: Spider-Island, Part Five
episodes.summary: It takes a last ditch, desperate effort for Spider-Man, Kid Arachnid, Anya and Harry to save Manhattan from the spider-monsters that the Jackal has created.

episodes.title: The Hobgoblin, Part 1
episodes.summary: Spider-Man takes on Doc Ock and his Sinister Five before they brainwash Spidey and destroy New York City.

episodes.title: The Hobgoblin, Part 2
episodes.summary: Spider-Man must find a way to stop Hobgoblin, who seems completely bent on doing whatever it takes to destroy Spider-Man.

episodes.title: How I Thwipped My Summer Vacation
episodes.summary: Peter wants to spend summer vacation as an ordinary kid but he keeps on having to become Spider-Man.

episodes.title: Take Two
episodes.summary: Spider-Man is excited to start his second year as a superhero and student at Horizon High but discovers that Doc Ock also claims to want a second chance.

episodes.title: Between an Ock and a Hard Place
episodes.summary: Spider-man's popularity nose dives, thanks to Pete's pictures in the Daily Bugle. Spidey battles a female 'Doc Ock' as the real plan of Dr Octopus is revealed.

episodes.title: Rise Above It All
episodes.summary: Spider-Man tangles with the Wakeriders, a thrill seeking group using Vulture technology.

episodes.title: School of Hard Knocks
episodes.summary: Spidey teams up with Ms Marvel to investigate a strange school.

episodes.title: Dead Man's Party
episodes.summary: Pete becomes weary of supplying footage to Jameson that is used to trash Spider-man's reputation. In a bid to scoop Pete, Eddie Brock tries to photograph substance V-252 and Venom is born.

episodes.title: Venom Returns
episodes.summary: Venom goes after Peter Parker's family and friends and threatens to expose his secret identity.

episodes.title: Bring on the Bad Guys Part One
episodes.summary: Super villain Overdrive tries to claim the bounty placed on Spider-man's head.

episodes.title: Bring on the Bad Guys Part Two
episodes.summary: Anya must step up and embrace being the Spider-Girl. Spider-Man is lured into Mysterio's funhouse and learns that there is a bounty on his head.

episodes.title: Bring on the Bad Guys Part Three
episodes.summary: Spider-Man faces off against his most bizarre bad guy yet, Jack O' Lantern. Then he turns Prowler, a reluctant villain, to the side of heroes when he helps him save his brother.

episodes.title: Bring on the Bad Guys Part Four
episodes.summary: Spidey tracks the identity of the mysterious boss that put a price on his head and who has been sending villains after him.

episodes.title: Brain Drain
episodes.summary: Spider-Man and Miles Morales discover who has been behind the mysterious bounty for Spider-Man's head.

episodes.title: The Living Brain
episodes.summary: Spider-Man must fight his way through the Super-Villain Holding Facility to challenge The Living Brain, the robot body that is housing the mind of Doctor Octopus.

episodes.title: The Day Without Spider-Man
episodes.summary: The Blood Gem accidentally reawakens Gwen Stacy's dormant spider-powers, turning her into Ghost-Spider.

episodes.title: My Own Worst Enemy
episodes.summary: Doc Ock, now in Spider-Man's body, intends to bring New York City to its knees, but instead finds his newly acquired brain still contains some of Peter Parker's memories.

episodes.title: Critical Update
episodes.summary: Doc Ock must adjust to his new life as a hero and is tested by rising crime boss Sand Girl.

episodes.title: A Troubled Mind
episodes.summary: Superior Spider-Man is confronted by the Avengers, who suspect that he is not who he claims to be.

episodes.title: Cloak and Dagger
episodes.summary: When a new criminal duo, Cloak and Dagger, emerge at Midtown High with the plan to take revenge against Midtown's benefactor Tiberius Stone and his company Alchemax, Superior Spider-Man must take them down and protect the school.

episodes.title: Superior
episodes.summary: Superior Spider-Man must face his most challenging opponent yet when Venom escapes from stasis and attacks Midtown High.

episodes.title: Brand New Day
episodes.summary: When a series of attacks by a suspected team of super-villains captures The Avengers, Spider-Man is left to figure out who could be behind it.

episodes.title: The Cellar
episodes.summary: Spider-Man takes his mission to The Cellar where he believes The Regent is using the powers of Cloak and Dagger, as well as other supervillains, to hold The Avengers captive.

episodes.title: The Road to Goblin War
episodes.summary: Spider-Man must take down the slick new villain, Slyde, as he steals various chemicals from around the city in an effort to create a deadly virus that could wipe out New York.

episodes.title: Goblin War Part One
episodes.summary: Spider-Man teams up with Spider-Girl, Ghost-Spider and Doc Ock to track down a new threat - the mysterious Goblin Nation.

episodes.title: Goblin War Part Two
episodes.summary: Spider-Man and Harry Osborn seek the Goblin King to determine who is behind the Goblin Mask.

episodes.title: Goblin War Part Three
episodes.summary: In order for Spider-Man to defeat the Goblin King, he must first bring together Doc Ock, Spider-Girl, Ghost-Spider, Miles Morales and Harry Osborn.

episodes.title: Goblin War Part Four
episodes.summary: The Spider Team must stop the Goblin King, now armed with a Goblin Mech Suit, before he destroys New York.

episodes.title: Web of Venom
episodes.summary: When Spider-Man and Max Modell experiment on a sample of Venom symbiote, it escapes and unleashes a weapon of unknown purpose.

episodes.title: Amazing Friends
episodes.summary: When Toddler Groot lands on Earth to deliver an urgent warning, Spider-Man must decode the message and keep him out of the evil clutches of A.I.M. and Baron Mordo.

episodes.title: Vengeance of Venom
episodes.summary: In the midst of a Klyntar attack on New York, Spider-Man must convince Marc Spector, a survivalist who has recently given up his secret hero identity as Moon Knight, to help him defend the city.

episodes.title: Spider-Man Unmasked
episodes.summary: After Spider-Man's friend is turned back into the rampaging Rhino by Swarm, Spidey is forced to battle for his life in the Underground Monster League contest.

episodes.title: Generations
episodes.summary: When Spider-Man discovers a vial of jackal serum at Horizon High, he and Ghost-Spider track down Jackal's secret lab in an attempt to destroy the villain's evil

episodes.title: Maximum Venom
episodes.summary: The Spider Team tracks down the missing Dr. Connors, who has undergone another transformation into the Lizard after learning from the Dark Goblin that the cure for the lizard serum he had been working for never existed. Just when that task is hard enough, the Spider Team discovers that Venom has returned from the dead to seek revenge on the Earth for thwarting his invasion.
